intelligence.essence: The Collective Agreement becomes ten boards, 3–5 sentences each, in the voice of a friend a child or a grandma understands — picture boards and text boards alternating, pictures harvested from the visual deck. If a presentation is long, every second must be earned.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine a big promise — the promise everyone makes when they join! It used to be SO long, like a giant book nobody could finish! Now it's just ten little picture boards — a picture with a tiny bit of writing, then just words, then a picture again — each one short and easy, like your friend Naya telling you herself! Even a little kid or a grandma can understand it — and when you understand it, you go "wow!" and you want to be part of it!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — the promise we all share used to be ever so long, dear, pages and pages that nobody could hold in their head. Now it's ten little boards, love — a picture with a sentence or two, then a few sentences of plain words, then a picture again — each one written like your friend Naya talking to you, so a child or a grandma understands every word, dear. And if anything is long, love, every single second of it must be worth your time — otherwise it gets made shorter.
